messages:
sam_support: @luis_csm @emily_cs P1 — trial activation stuck for ~37 users on account ACME-568. Bulk provisioning job (job_id=job-20260320-1518) returning 502 from provisioning-service, items staying in "pending". Customer can't start trial. Ticket S-8471 created.

ops_bot: [ALERT] provisioning-service 502 spikes (host=prov01) — 37 errors in 10m. Linked to S-8471.

luis_csm: Copy. Can you paste a concise impact summary we can give AE/CS? Also: set renewal risk to "watch" until triaged.

sam_support: Impact: 37 active invites failed, 12 users attempted signups in last 2 hours and got UX error "Activation failed, try again later". No data loss, just stalled onboarding. Short repro: run bulk job with payload X, see 502.

jordan_se: Temporary workaround: we can run manual invite flow from admin UI or trigger single-invite API for affected endusers. Script I ran for 5 users succeeded.

jordan_se: Example curl to invite one user (use admin token):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/invite" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"account_id":"ACME-568","email":"user@example.com"}'
```

sam_support: thanks @jordan_se — i've added manual invites to the runbook for the ticket. Will start processing affected emails now (batch size 10) and update S-8471 as we go.

emily_cs: Drafting comms to ACME. Proposed: "Hi <Name>, we're investigating an issue that may block activation for some trial users. We're running a targeted workaround to invite affected users manually so you can continue evaluating. We'll follow up with a permanent fix timeline ASAP. Apologies for the disruption — EMILY, CS lead." Happy to send if you both sign off.

luis_csm: Approve send. Add note: mention expected ETA for workaround (1h) and next update in 2h. Also escalate to AE (cc: @ae_sam) — this is a renewal-watch signal.

maria_oncall: oncall here — I'm looking at provisioning-service traces now. Initial hypothesis: rate limit proxy to prov01 tripping under burst from bulk job. Pushing a config tweak to increase backoff window, will try a rolling restart of prov01 in ~20m.

sam_support: Thanks @maria_oncall. Action items consolidated: 1) @maria_oncall infra attempt (20m) 2) @sam_support manual invites (in progress) 3) @emily_cs send customer comms (sending in 15m) 4) @luis_csm set renewal risk=watch and notify AE.

emily_cs: Sent the comms to ACME primary contact (thread: email-ACME-568-activation). Included workaround steps and ETA. I put the CS follow-up reminder for 24h.

luis_csm: I'll update the renewal dashboard and flag AE. If no stable fix in 48h, we'll open renewal mitigation playbook.

sam_support: updating S-8471 with manual invite log and infra notes. Will post another update when infra attempt completes.

ops_bot: [RESOLVE] provisioning-service 502 error rate decreased after restart of prov01. 10m rolling window: errors -> 4.

maria_oncall: Confirming — restart helped reduce error rate but we're still seeing occasional 502s on heavy bulk jobs. Will coordinate with EngRuntime to add safer backoff.

emily_cs: Follow-up plan in this thread: 1) complete manual invites for affected users (sam) 2) infra root-cause + fix (maria + eng-runtime) 3) customer update once permanent fix ETA known (emily) 4) AE sync if not fixed in 48h (luis). Renewal risk remains "watch" until closure.

luis_csm: Sounds good. Thanks everyone — please keep this thread updated and add any customer responses.

sam_support: Will do. Current status: 22/37 invites sent manually, S-8471 updated.
